# espalier_system (Data Source)

The container runtime on this host: whether it runs, its versions and the default kernel. A stopped runtime is reported, not an error, so configurations can check it as a precondition (espalier never starts the runtime: run `container system start`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fail early, with a useful message, when the runtime is not started.
data "espalier_system" "this" {
  lifecycle {
    postcondition {
      condition     = self.running
      error_message = "The container runtime is ${self.status}: run `container system start`."
    }
  }
}

output "runtime" {
  value = "container ${data.espalier_system.this.client_version}, kernel ${data.espalier_system.this.kernel_binary_path}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `client_version` (String) Version of the `container` command line tool.
- `kernel_binary_path` (String) Path of the default kernel inside its archive. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `kernel_digest` (String) Digest of the default kernel archive. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `kernel_url` (String) Where the default kernel archive comes from. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the runtime's services are running.
- `server_version` (String) Version of the runtime's API server. Null while the runtime is stopped.
- `status` (String) Status as reported by `container system status`, e.g. `running`, or `unregistered` after `container system stop`.
